points.title: The web isn't free to take, and most of it isn't worth learning
Pick sources per skill and modality
points.evidence: a cutoff date is not a knowledge guarantee

points.title: Every modality becomes tokens — and tokens are the cost
points.evidence: 10 s of 4K60 video = 19.4M tokens (16×16 patches, uncompressed)

sources.takeaway: Collection and tokenization already decide what the model can learn — and what it costs.

points.title: More data helps — until repeats saturate
points.evidence: Chinchilla: 70B / 1.4T beats 280B / 300B · repeats → ~16 effective passes (fitted law)

points.title: Reweighting works
points.evidence: same 8B model, same budget: baseline accuracy in 2.6× fewer steps (DoReMi)

points.title: Synthetic data is now part of the collection
points.evidence: Phi-4: 40% of training, 13.8 passes — and 12 passes beat 4

mixtures.takeaway: Same model, same budget — data decisions alone move quality.

points.title: Most of the crawl never reaches training
"Quality" is what trains a better model
points.evidence: the filter that agrees most with humans gives worse data

points.title: Dedup helps by removing huge clusters
points.evidence: global dedup threw away the better 90% of an old crawl

filtering.takeaway: Every filter is a hypothesis; training results are the test.

points.title: Most generated candidates are wrong
points.evidence: only ~24% of generated code solutions pass their own tests

points.title: A check is only as good as its tests
points.evidence: 80× more tests in HumanEval+ → pass@k drops by up to 19–29%

points.title: Repeat knowledge, not text
points.evidence: 10 rephrasings × 1 pass beat 1 text × 10 passes: SimpleQA 23.76 → 28.94

synthetic.takeaway: Generation is cheap; verification is what makes synthetic data useful.

points.title: A long window isn't long-context skill
points.evidence: the data must require distant links

points.title: Train with distractors and growing distance
Long data needs a share, not the whole mix
points.evidence: ProLong: 60% long + 40% short best; 100% long hurts

long-context.takeaway: Long context is taught by data that needs it.
long-context.source: Recap of D 22–D 24 · Kimi K3 §3.4; RULER; ProLong §3.2 / Figure 3

points.title: Record actions, results, failure and recovery
Synthetic environments transfer
points.evidence: τ²-bench ≈55% → ≈83% after RL on synthetic tasks only

trajectories.takeaway: Agent data is verified trajectories, not just answers.
